generic_domain.justification: After carefully analyzing the two available domains, I realize that '3d object representation' offers a more specific and precise focus compared to '3d representation', which is quite broad. The term 'object representation' inherently includes all aspects of representing three-dimensional objects, thereby encompassing the scope provided by '3d representation'. This specificity ensures better alignment with research goals aimed at detailed modeling of objects in 3D, making it the most comprehensive choice available.
